alignments.note: Jussive frame belongs to the verb whose mood it renders (rule 17); discontinuous around the subject under rule 25.
The ASV writes 'into' for this preposition (rule 11).
The emphatic possessive belongs whole to the suffix, headed on the pronoun (rule 18).
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes the supplied 'the', headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rule 46).
Explicit personal pronoun takes only its own English word (rule 20).
'Whilst that' is one subordinating rendering of the single connective morpheme, headed on the word the connective itself is (rule 55).
The ASV renders the verb 'escape'; the marginal literal gloss is set aside (rule 38).

review_notes: The marginal 'Hebrew pass over' was read and set aside; the printed 'escape' is what is aligned (rule 38).
'Whilst that' is taken as one rendering of עַד; the competing reading marks 'that' added under rule 55, but a connective morpheme does stand in the clause.
